info.name: BookFlow — Planned business examples (not smoke tests)
info.description: Contract examples only. These endpoints are not implemented yet and return 404 in the foundation. Never use this collection as evidence of passed business tests. Choose individual requests only after the responsible module is implemented. Populate tokens and IDs locally; never commit credentials.

request.description: Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Require trusted Origin and X-CSRF-Token equal to the signed, session-bound bookflow_csrf cookie; validate the signature and refresh-session binding. Frontend can read this cookie at Path=/ after a page reload. Rotate refresh token atomically, storing only a hash. Detect reuse and revoke the family. Return replacement cookies using their original paths. Frontend serializes refresh requests; never retry indefinitely.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Require trusted Origin and matching CSRF header/cookie; revoke the family and clear bookflow_refresh with Path=/api/v1/auth and bookflow_csrf with Path=/. An already revoked session remains logged out. Access JWT can remain valid until expiry.
Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Only role/status are writable. Reject disabling or demoting the last ACTIVE ADMIN using a transaction and consistent locking.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Body only bookId; borrower comes from verified principal. Enforce 3 active loans, no overdue loan, and no duplicate open loan for the same book. Due date is borrowedAt + 14*24 hours. Lock user → book → copy; insert loan and audit in one transaction. 409 codes include BOOK_UNAVAILABLE, LOAN_LIMIT_REACHED, OVERDUE_LOANS, ALREADY_BORROWED. Do not automatically retry ambiguous POST outcomes.
Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. MEMBER sees only own records; staff sees all. Stable order borrowedAt DESC, id DESC.
Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Return 404 for another MEMBER's loan; never reveal its existence.

item.name: [PLANNED] Create or read the unique return confirmation

request.description: Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Accept exactly {}. Server determines returnedAt/returnedBy on the first call. Lock copy then loan and update loan+audit in one transaction. Repeated PUT returns the original confirmation without a second audit or timestamp change.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Counts at asOf: activeBooks excludes archived books; serviceableCopies excludes RETIRED copies; activeLoans includes all unreturned loans; overdueLoans are unreturned loans with dueAt < asOf. No borrower personal data.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Inclusive from, exclusive to; reject from >= to. Order occurredAt DESC, id DESC. Never expose passwords, JWTs, refresh tokens or database credentials.
